description: Female, late thirties, charismatic arena announcer, full warm contralto with strong chest resonance, low speaking register, confident punchy video-game delivery, natural and adult, never high-pitched, never childlike, no falsetto.

Female, forties, sports broadcast and fighting-game announcer, deep husky alto voice with body and a little grit, strong breath support, commanding hype energy, crisp consonants, grounded mature tone, no squeaky or girlish sound.
Female, thirties, esports arena host, rich mezzo-contralto, powerful and rhythmic, big stadium energy, relaxed low pitch, natural adult performance, not cartoonish, not shrill.
Male, forties, fighting-game announcer, deep resonant bass-baritone with a slight rasp, huge hype energy, rhythmic punchy delivery, natural adult performance, not cartoonish.
Male, thirties, arena announcer, warm powerful baritone, bright energetic attack, rhythmic and bold, crisp consonants, natural video-game hype, no exaggerated growl.
